units.title: Number System and Binary Codes
topics: 1.1. Number System: Binary, Octal, Decimal, Hexadecimal
1.2. Number Conversion: Binary to Decimal, Decimal to Binary, Binary to Hexadecimal, Hexadecimal to Binary, Octal to Hexadecimal and Hexadecimal to Octal.
1.3. Complements: 1’s Complement, 2’s Complement Digital Electronics Course Code: 4332402 above level) Topics and Sub-topics
1.4. Signed and Unsigned Binary Numbers: Unsigned, Sign Magnitude, Range.
1.5. Binary Codes: Weighted Codes, Non weighed codes, Gray Code, BCD Code.
uos: 1.a. Explain different types of numbering systems.
1.b. Convert b i n a r y t o decimal, octal, hexadecimal and vice-versa.
1.d. Explain Signed and Unsinged Number system.
1.e. Describe weighted and un- weighted codes and their uses.

topics: 2.1. Logic Gates: AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, EX-OR, EX-NOR.

units.title: Combinational Logic Circuits
topics: 3.1. Combinational Circuits: Classification, Half Adder, Full Adder, Half Subtractor, Full Subtractor,1-bit Magnitude comparator, Multiplexers (2:1,4:1, 8:1), Demultiplexers (1:2, 1:4, 1:8), Decoder (2:4, 3:8) and Encoder (Octal to Binary).
uos: 3.b. Explain Working of various combinational circuits using Truth Table, Logic Circuits and Simplify Boolean Expression.
